Highlights:
# NV5000-N 

 500GB 1TB 

• NVMe M.2 PCIe Gen 4 x4 interface

• Supports S.M.A.R.T./TRIM Command/NCQ

• Support PS5 M.2 expansion

### NV5000-N M.2 PCIE SSD

#### NV5000-N uses PCIe Gen 4 ×4 channels, high bandwidth, low latency

### PCIe Gen 4 ×4 Interface

With NV5000-N strong performance, it creates an excellent performance in file transfer, material loading, and game reading

### 3D NAND Flash

Selected 3D NAND Flash chips, which have higher capacity density and reliability than 2D structure, and also supports LDPC Intelligent Error Correction

### Increasing Game Storage

The NV5000-N SSD can meet the expansion requirements of PS5, and easily upgrade with faster boot-ups experienced

Title: NV5000-t M.22280
URL: https://www.netac.com/uploads/20260331/90ddf8d78f208ffe80bad9de81048899.pdf
Published: N/A
Author: wendy
Highlights:
The Netac NV5000-t M.2 NVMe SSD uses an ultra-high-speed PCIe Gen4 *4 interface and complies with the NVMe 1.4 standard. With read and write speeds up to 4800MB/s and 4600MB/s respectively, which makes it the best choiceforyour PC and laptop upgrading. Availableincapacityfrom 500GB-1TB to meet your system's needs. It supports SLC caching, which can improveefficiency when loading applications or copyingfiles.

PCIe Gen4 *4 Interface

Netac NV5000-t uses PCIe Gen4*4channels,high bandwidth, low latency, reading speed is up to 4800MB/s, which can achieve fast loading and instant response.

Intelligent Temperature Control

Equipped with intelligent temperature control technology, which can monitor and regulate the temperature of the components inreal-time, sothat the SSD temperature is maintained within a reasonable range to ensure the stabilityof work.

Efficiency 3D NAND

Selected 3D NAND Flash chips have higher capacity density and reliability than2Dstructures.It also supports LDPC Intelligent Error Correction, significantly prolonging the service life of the hard disk.

Storage More

Three capacities are freely selectable, providing a broad platform for file interaction, material copying, and game storage.

Highlights

• NVMe M.2 PCIe Gen4 *4 interface 
• Read/write speed up to 4800/4600MB/s 
• Supports S.M.A.R.T./TRIM Command/NCQ 
• Compact M.2 2280 form factor 
• 5-year limited warranty 

Best-Fit Applications

• Laptops 
• Desktop PCs 
• PS5 

* It is designed for consumer notebooks and desktops and is not recommended for industrial or server applications.
